en.disclaimer: Descriptive arithmetic for values and dates you enter. This tool has no reference ranges and does not assess health, diagnose, predict outcomes, recommend retesting, or guide treatment. Confirm marker names, units, values, and dates against the original report.
en.unit_note: No unit conversion is performed. Every reading for the same marker must use the same unit.
en.insufficient_data: Not enough distinct dates to calculate a slope
en.empty_state: Add at least one complete reading to see a descriptive summary.
en.incomplete_state: Complete each marker, value, unit, and date; use the same unit for each marker.
